notes.title: Ember's Journal 5: Studio Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/2cdd35a932b4c62e29fc249ed6f9d08550e92e8c.png

Wishlists for End of Ember are tracking slowly but surely, and we are now at 653. We got a nice little spike around SAGE which tells us that doing events and activations like that are good, so we've got some big news coming up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/bed48eaeb8f3ea75d007c7e2aec3e0dd7ec56319.png

Super exciting news! End of Ember will be featured in both the Frosty Games Fest (June 8th, 2025) and the Horror Games Awards Showcase in Summer (May 31st) and Halloween. We will have new, never-before-seen trailers showing at both these events so check them out and support the events that support us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/1b7c58ef954a9ca2c8a33d2e3089f75c022f75c1.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/f635a75ed034c50415f6582b4f3a4c16bfe225d8.png

We've been posting fairly consistently across all our socials with a big focus on short form content: we love showing current developments, so check out this throwback introducing us back in the day :

[previewyoutube=jrmgTeQxoF4;full][/previewyoutube]

Don't forget to follow us on any of the platforms to stay up to date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/a20f4e947d26335139cdf054d9d6e6cc68f74918.png

Dan and Eli have been working real hard on the game to get a new build ready for AVCon: Adelaide's anime and gaming festival in early July. It's mostly another iteration of the project rebuild, but players will certainly see some new content, including a few new rooms and some more introductory stages which explains what happens when Ember first gets to Hell.

Of course, for folks not in Adelaide, we will update the build on our Itch page, but this is probably the last open update we will make until we launch the full demo on Steam. We hope to have an announcement on that date soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45279952/238772ea3a0051e408021648491ba1e14b7ad329.png

Bad Plan is rocking along as usual - we are looking to bring to some new folks in to help with the technical aside of the game development. Stay tuned for announcements!

Chad, Dan and Eli
xo
